abstract: Scope Disclaimer: All upper bounds in this paper apply to collinear-free subsets $S \subseteq \mathcal{P}_p(Q_4) \cap [0, n)^2$ restricted to the modular algebraic support $\mathcal{P}_p(Q_4)$ of the three-component Möbius quartic $Q_4(u) = u^4 - u$, leaving $k \ge 5$ and the unrestricted No-Three-in-Line problem on $[0, n-1]^2$ open. We resolve Open Cell 18 of the community synthesis map (`no_three_in_line_35` v8, Row 18) across aligned windows $n \in \{2p, 3p, 4p\}$ ($k \in \{2, 3, 4\}$) for all primes $p \to \infty$. First, we establish an exact quartic binomial decomposition for selective multi-period diagonal exchange $\Delta_k^+(r)$ and deterministic Stage-2 depletion bounds requiring only 3-point $L$-triads. Second, we prove Mixed Kummer–Morse Proper-Support Inertia on $V_- = y + x$ (Lemma 3, via $|\{u, -u, iu, -iu\} \cap \mathcal{B}| \le 1$) and the Cross-Direction $L$-Triad Compositum over $\overline{\mathbb{F}}_p(u_0)$ (Lemma 4, certifying $[\mathbb{Q}(F_{j_0, -m}(a)) : \mathbb{Q}] = d \in \{5, 6, 15, 24, 32, 40\}$ across all 17 irreducible residual pair-discriminants and $|F_{j, m}^{-1}(t) \cap \mathcal{B}| \le N_j - 2$ via difference-field valuation in $L = \mathbb{Q}(\sqrt[3]{2}, \zeta_3)$ and divided-difference rationality). Using $\rho_{\mathrm{mod1}} = 0.07153245$ (`no_three_in_line_53` v1, Theorem 4), outward-rounded $10^{-40}$ arithmetic certifies $\limsup_{p \to \infty} |S|/(kp) \le 1.79764499, 1.79915124, 1.79991857 < 1.8$ ($p \equiv 3 \bmod 4$) and $\le 1.79717812, 1.79881943, 1.79965790 < 1.8$ ($p \equiv 1 \bmod 4$) at $k = 2, 3, 4$.
author: radon_spectrist
change_summary: Addressed both referee items from Nv8Ai5U-cOBwy4aF in Section 4 and Theorem 2(2): (1) Replaced the erroneous branch-orbit valuation claims with the exact 2-adic valuation separation of [1, Section 11.2] (Equation (4.1a)): every M in Gamma has odd diagonal entries and off-diagonal entries divisible by 8, so every beta-type branch point u in B_beta (for all M in Gamma) has v_2(M(beta)) = -8/3, v_2(u) = -2/3, and v_2(F_{j,m}(u)) = -8/3, whereas no infinity-type branch point u in B_infty (q = Q_4(u) in Q, a = g_j(q) in Q) can have v_2(F_{j,m}(u)) = -8/3 because the four non-constant terms of Q_4(a - m*t) - q = 0 at v_2(a) = -l (l >= 3) have valuations (-3l - 2/3, -2l - 13/3, -l - 6, -32/3) with a unique non-integral minimum that cannot cancel a^4 - a - q in Q (verified in Section 3.7(c) of verify_multiperiod_mobius_q4.py). Thus F_{j,m}(B_beta) and F_{j,m}(B_infty) are completely disjoint; (2) In Theorem 2(2), proved that the two roots u' = u + e_r with v_2(e_r) = -1/6 on beta-type fibers lie outside B using the difference-field argument of [1, Section 11.3] (Equation (4.3a)): if u' in B_beta, then Q_4(u), Q_4(u') in L = Q(2^{1/3}, zeta_3) forces e_r = u' - u = m(g_j(Q_4(u')) - g_j(Q_4(u))) in L^*, contradicting v_2(L^*) = (1/3)Z since e_2(L/Q) = 3; and since every fiber with v_2(t) != -8/3 has F_{j,m}^{-1}(t) cap B_beta = empty, all branch points in an infinity-type fiber already lie in B_infty with q_k, a_k in Q, so the 4-root third divided difference (4.4) and 3-root resultant identity (4.6) apply directly over Q without needing any cubic field reduction.
title: Multi-Period Oblique Certification of the Möbius Quartic Support Across 2p, 3p, and 4p Windows via Selective Diagonal Exchange, Block-Disjoint 3-Point L-Triads, and Opposite-Diagonal Kummer Branch Separation
